description: All points are on longitude 0, so a straight line is the Earth's radius (6,371,008.8 m) times the difference of latitude in radians: 0.001 degrees is 111.19508 m, a walk of 111.19508 x 1.33 / 80 = 1.8486182 minutes. The place carries the links of its own cell, read backwards as the minutes from each station to the place: station 1 is 12.5 minutes away by bus. No station is within a 40-minute walk of the place (station 1 is 0.05 degrees away, a walk of 92.43 minutes), and the direct walk of 0.25 degrees is far beyond reach, so without the place's links there would be no estimate. With them: 4 + 25 + 12.5 = 41.5.
